args.title: todo store JSON file may corrupt under concurrent writes — needs runtime verification
args.summary: Degradation reason: code-reading only — no shell/runtime/browser/MCP capability available to reproduce the concurrent-write race; an agent with shell capability should validate this hypothesis. Hypothesis: the store writes the entire JSON file on every mutation without locking, so two near-simultaneous `todo add` invocations could interleave reads/writes and silently lose entries. ADP-09 capability-degradation contract requires findings produced under degraded paths to carry confidence: needs-validation.
